= quoted-contexts(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Conditional comparisons
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-02
:state: <early>
:condition-enabled:

ifeval::["{state}" == '<early>']
:header-result: accepted
endif::[]

== NAME

quoted-contexts - retain conditional source order

== DESCRIPTION

C01 Header assignment: {header-result}.

ifeval::["{state}" == '<early>']
C02 The initial value matches.
endif::[]

:state: >late<

ifeval::["{state}" == '>late<']
:body-result: accepted
C03 The body assignment takes effect.
endif::[]

ifeval::["{state}" == '<early>']
F01 The old value must not match after assignment.
endif::[]

C04 Body assignment: {body-result}.

ifdef::condition-enabled[]
ifeval::['[nested] <= value' == "[nested] <= value"]
C05 A quoted comparison nests inside ifdef.
endif::[]
endif::condition-enabled[]

ifeval::['<outer>' == "<outer>"]
ifeval::["<inner>" != '<different>']
C06 Active nested comparisons include their content.
endif::[]
endif::[]

ifeval::['<outer>' != "<outer>"]
ifeval::['<inner>' == "<inner>"]
F02 A true inner comparison cannot activate a false parent.
endif::[]
endif::[]

ifeval::['<outer>' == "<outer>"]
ifeval::['<inner>' != "<inner>"]
F03 A false inner comparison stays hidden.
endif::[]
C07 Closing the inner comparison restores its parent.
endif::[]

ifeval::["<list>" == '<list>']
* C08 A conditional list item remains a list.
endif::[]

ifeval::['<block>' == "<block>"]
----
C09 A conditional listing remains a listing.
----
endif::[]

ifeval::["<formatted>" == '<formatted>']
C10 *Formatting* remains available in included content.
endif::[]

C11 Final content keeps its original source location.
